templates.name: static-business-site
templates.description: Dependency-free static business website starter with generic placeholders.

preview_assets.asset_policy: Preview PNG/GIF/JPG files are optional human-facing documentation assets hosted in GitHub Releases to keep the main checkout lightweight. The agent workflow works from markdown references, JSON presets, scripts, and templates without loading binary previews. A true full-clone history reduction would require an explicit git history rewrite plan.

scripts.name: install
scripts.description: Installs the skill into common local agent skills directories.

scripts.name: generate_preview_assets
scripts.description: Regenerates style preview images and interaction GIFs from the preset catalog.

scripts.name: audit_static_site
scripts.description: Checks local static site assets, anchors, duplicate IDs, viewport metadata, image alt attributes, CSS url() references, optional strict SEO/GEO launch metadata, and optional final-delivery placeholders.

scripts.name: package_runtime_skill
scripts.description: Creates a lightweight runtime ZIP for team and partner installation in compatible agent tools.

compatibility.notes: Core workflow uses SKILL.md, references, scripts, and assets. agents/openai.yaml is Codex-specific UI metadata and can be ignored by other runtimes. Claude Code compatibility was reported as tested by the maintainer; keep future runtimes in expected until verified.
